newsitem.title: RUSSIA: FULL TEXT OF YELTSIN ADDRESS ON ROUBLE.
newsitem.headline: FULL TEXT OF YELTSIN ADDRESS ON ROUBLE.

text.p: The following is the full text of President Boris Yeltsin's statement on Monday on redenominating the rouble.

"Today we have taken a decision which affects all of us. From January 1, 1998, Russia will carry out a thousandfold redenomination of the rouble. Three superfluous zeroes will disappear from currency notes. A thousand rouble note will become a normal rouble note. And simultaneously, from January 1, we will pay one rouble for goods costing 1,000 roubles.

"We are going to avoid stresses and shocks when introducing the new currency notes. There will be no exchange of old money for new. Especially, there will be no exchange "within three days". New coins and notes of the Bank of Russia will start circulating from January 1, 1998. But during the whole of 1998, circulation of old and new notes will be allowed. It will be compulsory for all banks, companies and shops to accept both old and new notes. By January 1, 1999, we shall take out from circulation the old notes, but for more years, until the end of 2002, they will be accepted for exchange by all offices of the Bank of Russia.
"Thus, we shall smoothly replace old money with new. And, I want to stress this in particular, the replacement will take place without any restrictions.

"The redenomination of the rouble and the change in the scale of prices, will definitely make life easier for people. The basic unit of small change will be not 1,000 roubles but one rouble. Without these extra zeroes it will be easier and more normal to make payments.
"Besides, nobody will lose anything as a result of this reform. Nobody's interests will be hurt. The reform will not be a confiscation.

"It is not by chance that the planned reform has been announced in advance. I want everyone to prepare for it well. Not to have any hurry or nervousness. In the last 50 years, everything connected with monetary reform always hit ordinary people here. Now that is ruled out. As president, I guarantee this.

"Today we are in reliable control of money in circulation and of inflation. People know that we no longer have sharp price rises. The prices of basic goods are practically stable and we are determined and certain that they will remain so. That is why we took this decision to carry out a monetary reform. And with it we declare today: There will be no more inflation. That is all over. New zeros will never again appear on our notes.

"The Russian rouble has become one of the most stable currencies in Eastern Europe. Once you receive your wages, it is no longer necessary today as it was not long ago to run to the exchange kiosk. You can keep your bank savings in rouble accounts. People must know for sure that we will not try to solve the country's economic problems with the help of the printing pres. This has never been the case and it will never happen!

"Let's remember Russian history. As a result of the monetary reform carried out 100 years ago, Russia received a full-weight "golden" rouble. On the eve of World War One it was the hardest, most reliable currency in Europe. I believe the day is not far off when our Russian rouble will again excite the same respect in the world.
